records.scope_and_limits: `TireCalibration`, record/file loading, geometry/provenance, explicit curve and inclusive load range. No implicit pressure scaling.
Monotone table, interval force integral, unilateral damping, no extrapolation and range errors. CLI `tire_curve` retains energy in joules.
Package organization becomes an explicit native library and registry; no Python module discovery.

Version/profile identity, evidence matching, bounded results, 14 load/shaft stands and five-operation mechanics pipeline are implemented. Native provenance replaces Python package versions; subordinate partial rigs/benchmarks prevent a complete source-equivalence claim.

`assess_run`, tuple grouping, numeric integer-seed ordering, candidate/baseline exclusions and horizon checks. Mixed unusual seed types and Python truthiness of non-boolean intervention values are narrower at the native typed boundary.

All 41 registry entries, original bounds, convergence keys/floors, mandatory-vs-diagnostic selection, complete-suite and exact-dt gates. `jobs=1` executes sequentially; source isolated worker execution for jobs 2–32 is explicitly rejected. Native versions are declared as native versions.

Accounted physical steps and real research `PolicySession` ticks, setup/warmup/latency, output-directory exclusivity, validity, hashes and recording publication. Native research capture uses the existing native recording contract; equivalence of setup/retention costs and sampled diagnostics requires captures. Source `preview_mode()` is already removed and raises `preview path removed`; the port preserves that rejection.

Ordered/contiguous support intervals, observed-vs-unknown support, model/energy invalidity, first bad/unknown time, reason counts, valid prefix and separate completeness. Unknown observations are never invented as zero-valued evidence.

Bounds and flat/step/incline matrix over actual distributed stands. Native metric decoding currently expects numeric JSON values, while Python `float()` also accepts some strings/bools. Stand station limits and custom-material surface remain narrower; empty CLI bounds do not constitute accepted evidence.

Two-body wheel stand, kinetic/material ledger, flat/step/incline rigs, six road profiles and retained trajectories. The private native stand currently uses the declared default density/mu; the Python helper's arbitrary optional density/mu inputs are not exposed. Some NumPy scalar ufunc/matrix lowering still needs a dedicated bitwise comparison.

Both source NNLS density fits, 12 flat and three incline stands, all six roads, time/road/station axes, persistent events and finest-pair acceptance. Numerical qualification depends on the partial contact stand producer; report/provenance serialization is native.

Seven unit schemas, whole-experiment splits, measured conditions, sensor/estimate provenance, per-experiment errors, declared parameter/error budgets and canonical ASCII hashing. The public C++ holdout API is a one-dimensional span; Python accepts same-shaped multidimensional NumPy inputs. Existing native JSON byte/number limits also bound metadata.

Actual compiled suspension fixture, four-joint bounded closure continuation, 784.8 N frame load, viscous rollers, three transmissions, all stroke/torque/dt combinations and original force gates. `shock_total` is presently reconstructed from split damper/HBO components: subtracting then adding HBO can change the last bits. The discarded source scalar must be exposed or recomputed exactly before bitwise qualification.

Ordered length-delimited source hashing and actual native build lock/MuJoCo/provider identity. This intentionally reports a native identity; Python/PEP 440 marker evaluation and every direct package version are not reproduced. Current lock verification covers the build-lock digest and loaded MuJoCo, not every transitive image.

Split rejection, synthetic declaration and explicit boolean calibration gates. Source `is_synthetic` applies Python `str()` to an arbitrary `source` object; the C++ record boundary requires a string. The discrepancy-budget constants remain in the Python authority and are not automatically applied or invented as new thresholds.

Resolution validation, interval integration, all comparison criteria, seven cases, physical seeds, periodic station projection, rows/events/metrics and finest-pair summaries. Jobs 2–16 are explicitly unavailable. Runtime rows consume each immutable finalized interval once; this differs from the source's repeated `sim.physical.sample` read after each physics step. Initial state files preserve the exact payload bytes used for their hashes.
Explicit scalar domains and `mu * rear_fraction - grade`; result is labelled necessary and never sufficient for a completed climb.

Quasistatic load formula and full free-pitch rigid stand with normal/tangent reaction and moment checks. Source NumPy scalar trig lowering and small matrix products need confirmation against platform captures.
`ValidPrefix::observe`: seen/accepted counters, first invalid record, strict evidence booleans, positive interval, loads and impulse prefix. A later valid row cannot resume acceptance.
All eight independent SIL gates, optional completion, no calibration/safety promotion and ordered trapezoidal trace integral.
Actual tendon-based shaft/freehub stand, arbitrary positive ratio, overrun, constraint reaction, angular acceleration and shaft-power identity. Uses actual MuJoCo actuation/constraint results.

Required release gates, candidate choice, hashed evidence manifests, measured-holdout authentication, outcome ordering and all 18 scenarios. Matrix execution inherits the immutable-interval and native-seed differences; no reference release was created.

Flat/native static, exact requested-sag fitting bounds, brake hold, low mu, airborne passive/released rider, road runs and terrain refinement. All source horizons/thresholds remain. Live published interval observation replaces the source's per-physics-step sample access; source-vs-native instantaneous observer timing and integral weighting must be qualified.
Compiled airborne articulated tree, actual rider/internal forces, ballistic/momentum/work invariants and original two-second horizon.

Nine original factors, ten-second horizon, baseline-resumed and causal-replay-resolved gates. Inherits replay observation differences; unsupported motor-only replay is retained as an explicit failed experiment.

Schedules, profile loading, diagnostic rows, replay, coast/resume diagnosis and JSON/gzip reports. All seven modes remain; motor-only open loop rejects. Native report writing uses actual gzip stored blocks and atomic native publication. Row cadence is the distinct finalized interval stream rather than repeated/stale `sample` access.
Exact component-name selection, CPython-style active-work sum, separate passive, net and motor work.

Every public stand and compiled chain derivative is implemented against actual compiled models/production laws. Small-matrix and NumPy-vs-libm scalar lowering still needs direct comparison; a manually reconstructed small rotation is not asserted bitwise equal.

Independent body inertial Jacobians, world inertia, CoM/linear/angular momentum, actual complete airborne tree, passive/active/motor-only cases, gravity impulse, free-pitch conservation and separate roll/yaw constraint evidence. Task 3.19 reference tests reuse this API.

Pure brush-step loop, exact slip convention, Stribeck cap, loss/storage/stiffness metadata and integer horizon. Default-material provenance is explicit through a supplied tire record or physics profile.
